$description: Light-mode semantic colors → :root. Names are shadcn's contract vocabulary (so borrowed Radix behaviour compiles unmodified). Values are shadcn's neutral seed and are REPLACED with ours in Phase 4 (re-skin) — that is a one-file edit here, no component churn.

destructive-foreground.$description: Text ON a destructive fill. REDEFINED 2026-08-03: shadcn's dark value was a red (oklch 0.58 0.22 27), i.e. a colour for destructive text on a NEUTRAL surface — which is why its own Button bypasses this token and hard-codes `text-white` (A-D-018). Near-white in both modes so the token can actually be used.

input.$description: CONTROL-AFFORDANCE stroke — the edge that identifies an input as an input, and therefore governed by WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1). DARKENED 2026-08-03: shadcn's 0.922 measured 1.26:1 on background, which is not a marginal miss — at that ratio a low-vision user sees a blank rectangle. L=0.669 lands exactly on 3.00:1. Distinct from `border`, which is decorative and may stay light.

ring.$description: Focus border colour. DARKENED 2026-08-03: shadcn's 0.708 measured 2.58:1, below the 3:1 a focus indicator needs — the mechanism keyboard users navigate by was itself failing. L=0.629 gives 3.51:1, deliberately above the minimum since the halo is drawn at 50% and dilutes further.

focus-ring.$description: The focus HALO — `ring` at 50%. Named because the treatment (1px border swap to `ring` + a 3px halo at 50%) appears verbatim in Button and Input and will recur in every focusable control (Q8).

backdrop.$description: Dialog/overlay scrim. shadcn hard-codes bg-black/50 with no token behind it, so Figma had nothing to bind. Named per v1's own `backdrop`.

shadow-subtle.$description: Shadow ink. Figma EFFECT STYLES have no mode support, so a theme-aware shadow needs its colour as a variable the effect binds to — these four are that. v1's shadowSubtle.

shadow-flat.$description: Migrated from v1's elevation() (R-09). Light shadows are slate-tinted (#1C2024), not pure black — that tint is why v1's elevation reads warmer than shadcn's fixed black alpha.

shadow-overlay.$description: THE DIALOG SURFACE uses this (D-027), replacing shadcn's shadow-lg.
